# ubiops_instance_type_group (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps instance type group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_instance_type_group" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-instance-group"

  instance_types_json = jsonencode([
    {
      id               = "256mb"
      priority         = 1
      schedule_timeout = 300
    },
    {
      id               = "512mb"
      priority         = 2
      schedule_timeout = 600
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_types_json` (String) A list of instance types that are in this group.
- `name` (String) Name of the instance type group
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the created instance type group (UUID)
- `time_created` (String) The date when the instance type group was created
- `time_updated` (String) The date when the instance type group was last updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_instance_type_group.example my-project/group-uuid
```
